title: In a 600 x 400 window a new agent chat's composer menu opens and closes: the page reports the menu panel open, then gone, and no native overlay stays behind
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window of 600 x 400 pt (the script resized it with debug.window_frame)
converted from scripts/cmux-next/page-popup-escape-e2e.py (cx-6k6cg, #19819), which stays for the panel geometry; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-094.json links them

steps.note: New Agent Chat (palette.newAgentChat); the settle covers the composer mounting

expect.noReceiptReason: a debug click on the composer's own control runs no action; the page's menu panel is its result

steps.note: the composer's folder menu (Location), as the script opens it

expect.noReceiptReason: closing the composer's menus runs no action; the gone panel is its result

steps.note: script row 'closing the Location menu removes the panel'

invariants: windows at chat-shown lists one window whose frame is 600 x 400 pt
the chat's page at menu-open lists one menu panel more than at chat-shown, and at menu-closed its panels equal chat-shown's
overlays at menu-closed equal overlays at chat-shown: no native popup host is left in front of the page
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the cited bug itself (cx-6k6cg): whether the menu went past the window's edge into a native panel, drew every row unclipped and stayed on its screen; that is the panel's geometry (debug.page_popup), which no facet records
the folder menu's rows: they list the Mac's projects, and the hermetic HOME has none, so the case cannot make the menu taller than the window
the commands list (/) and the file list (@query): they list what a running agent sent
